notes: The nominalizing article of to proteron (s001) is unrepresented under rule 23, 'before' answering to proteron alone and the ASV writing no determiner for the article to anchor.
s010 'obtained mercy' heads on 'mercy' under rule 91, 'obtained' being the empty support verb; 1TI.1.16 renders the same lexeme the same way, so rule 24's habit is kept.
s003 onta carries the supplied 'though' and subject under rule 86, headed on the copular verb, which is all the participle is.
